goal_policy.multi_stage: first recorded expert frame satisfying each stage predicate
goal_policy.final_goal: last recorded frame; preserve the episode task prompt

stage_texts: Hold the hammer aligned above the target block without striking it.
Strike the target block with the hammer.

stage_criteria.description: grasped hammer head aligned above block without block contact
stage_criteria.name: hammer_prestrike_aligned

stage_texts: Place the first colored block at its ranked target.
Place the second colored block at its ranked target.
Complete the color ranking by placing all blocks at their targets.

stage_criteria.description: first RGB block is at its seed-specific target
stage_criteria.name: ranked_prefix_at_least_1

stage_criteria.description: first two RGB blocks are at their seed-specific targets
stage_criteria.name: ranked_prefix_at_least_2

stage_texts: Place the first block at its size-ranked target.
Place the second block at its size-ranked target.
Complete the size ranking by placing all blocks at their targets.

stage_criteria.description: first expert-placed size block is at its target
stage_criteria.name: ranked_prefix_at_least_1

stage_criteria.description: first two expert-placed size blocks are at their targets
stage_criteria.name: ranked_prefix_at_least_2

stage_texts: Hold the small trash bin with the left hand in a stable pour-ready pose above the large bin.
Dump the contents of the small bin into the large bin.

stage_criteria.description: desk bin is held by the left gripper above the large bin before dumping
stage_criteria.name: left_pour_ready

stage_texts: Present the microphone in the central handover region while the giving hand still holds it.
Transfer the microphone so only the receiving hand holds it.

stage_criteria.description: microphone is in the handover region and retained by the donor
stage_criteria.name: donor_presents_in_center

stage_texts: Secure the mug in the receiving right hand after the handoff.
Hang the mug securely on the target rack.

stage_criteria.description: right gripper securely holds the mug after handoff
stage_criteria.name: right_receiver_owns_mug

stage_texts: Lift the playing card clearly away from the table center.
Move and release the playing card at the required final location.
Raise the laptop lid to a clearly partially open angle.
Open the laptop lid to the required final angle.
Place one bread securely inside the basket.
Place all remaining bread securely inside the basket.

stage_criteria.description: at least one bread satisfies RoboTwin basket geometry
stage_criteria.name: bread_count_at_least_1

stage_texts: Place the can securely inside the basket.
Lift the basket while keeping the can inside.

stage_criteria.description: can contacts basket, is off the table, and lies within basket envelope
stage_criteria.name: can_inside_basket

stage_texts: Place one can securely inside the plastic box.
Place both cans securely inside the plastic box.

stage_criteria.description: at least one can satisfies RoboTwin box geometry
stage_criteria.name: can_count_at_least_1

stage_texts: Place one shoe securely at its target location.
Place both shoes securely at their target locations.

stage_criteria.description: at least one shoe is within the partial-placement target envelope (quaternion tolerance 0.08)
stage_criteria.name: shoe_count_at_least_1

stage_texts: Hold the phone aligned at the entrance of the phone stand.
Insert and release the phone securely in the stand.

stage_criteria.description: phone functional point is within the stand-entry envelope while either arm still grasps it
stage_criteria.name: phone_at_stand_entry

stage_texts: Place one bottle securely inside the dustbin.
Place two bottles securely inside the dustbin.
Place all three bottles securely inside the dustbin.
Open the cabinet sufficiently for placing the object inside.
Place the object securely inside the cabinet.
Place the first block stably at the stack location.
Complete a stable stack of two blocks.
Complete a stable stack of three blocks.

stage_criteria.description: block1 is at the seed-specific stack base
stage_criteria.name: base_block_stable

stage_criteria.description: block2 is stably stacked on block1
stage_criteria.name: stable_layers_at_least_2

stage_texts: Place the first block stably at the stack location.
Complete a stable stack of two blocks.

stage_criteria.description: block1 is at the seed-specific stack base
stage_criteria.name: base_block_stable

stage_texts: Place the first bowl stably at the stack location.
Complete a stable stack of two bowls.
Complete a stable stack of three bowls.

stage_criteria.description: bowl1 is at the seed-specific stack base
stage_criteria.name: base_bowl_stable

stage_criteria.description: bowl2 is stably stacked on bowl1
stage_criteria.name: stable_layers_at_least_2

stage_texts: Hold the seal aligned just above the stamping target.
Press the seal onto the target and complete the stamp.

stage_criteria.description: grasped seal aligned above target before release
stage_criteria.name: seal_prepress_aligned
